route_name: High-pressure dispersion of chemically isolated cellulose nanocrystals
association_basis: The source disperses chemically modified and hydrolyzed CNC feed using M-110P. This plan begins with washed, already chemically isolated CNCs. It does not replace hydrolysis or describe purely mechanical CNF production. Alternative models need sample compatibility, chamber and process qualification.

route_name: Spray drying of aqueous cellulose-nanocrystal dispersions
association_basis: The methods distinguish CNC from nanofibrillated-cellulose feeds and identify BUCHI B-290. The output is dried CNC-containing particles/agglomerates. Nanoscale individual crystals, unchanged morphology and reversible redispersion are not guaranteed. Alternative dryers require feed, solvent, containment and operating qualification.

route_name: Aqueous redispersion and aggregate assessment of dried cellulose nanocrystals
association_basis: Abstract-level evidence for static, stirred and ultrasound-assisted dispersion comparisons and the difficulty of redispersing spray-dried CNC aggregates. The sequence is a curator planning abstraction. No operating dose, sonication energy, surfactant composition or success/yield is inferred.

route_name: Cellulose nanocrystals
association_basis: Chemically isolated crystalline cellulose nanoparticles, including source-reported phosphorylated CNCs. Distinct from mechanical CNF production. Dried CNC-containing agglomerates require separate morphology and redispersibility assessment.
